description_en: Call the CheckMonitorAlert operation to check whether the alert monitoring feature of Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) is enabled for a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用CheckMonitorAlert接口校验指定云数据库ClickHouse集群是否开通了ARMS（Application Real-Time Monitoring Service）服务提供的监控告警功能
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse check-monitor-alert --db-cluster-id cc-bp13s14l8498l0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckMonitorAlert

parameters.description_en: The region ID. Call the [DescribeRegions](~~170875~~) operation to query region IDs.
